inputs.label: Lupin the Third: The Shooting NAOMI sets
inputs.help: Your own sets lupinshoo.zip and naomi.zip (GDS-0018). Leave them zipped.

inputs.label: Lupin the Third GD-ROM image (gds-0018.chd)
inputs.help: The gds-0018.chd from your lupinshoo folder.

steps.why: The game reads the sets from Download. The guide has the user allow file access when prompted.

steps.text: Open Lupin the Third VR from Library > Unknown Sources. If it asks for file access, allow it. Then select Play.

notes: Releases also carry a PCVR zip and a source zip. Granting the appop over adb is not yet tested on a Quest.
